prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Brakka Fenn. Character visual motifs: heavyset one-eyed town marshal whose gauntlets are giant document stamps, wearing battered city uniform and public warrants.
TOP LEFT: Repeat Offender. Ability concept: an enemy that damages the same ally twice within 3 s gains a public Offender tag for 4 s (once per enemy / 8 s), giving Brakka 10% faster movement when approaching that enemy.
TOP RIGHT: File Complaint. Ability concept: stamps a 45-GU-wide circle on the ground, warning for 0.5 s. Offenders within receive a 0.4 s stagger and ordinary enemies take light damage; nobody is automatically grabbed.
BOTTOM LEFT: Right of Way. Ability concept: Brakka forms a 55-GU escort path **to one protected ally**, briefly body-blocking incoming basic attacks when physically between attacker and ally. If he leaves the path he loses the guard.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Writ Served. Ability concept: targets one Offender in 110 GU and projects a **public 75-GU exclusion disk** around that enemy for 3 s. The tagged enemy is free to walk **out** at any time; if they remain and attack the previously targeted ally, Brakka's counterstamp inflicts one 0.55 s disarm and moderate damage. Not an automatic targeted slam or suppression.
